item.title: Starmer moves to ban social media for children under 16
item.description:
UK Prime Minister Keir Starmer announced a ban on social media access for children under 16, describing the move as "real change for our children and our future." The policy goes further than Australia's restrictions and includes limits on gaming apps that allow minors to contact strangers. Starmer said legislation would be passed by year's end, with the ban taking effect by spring.
